releases.body:

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Novaenia/OWMouseFix/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
releases.bodyZh:
## 有什么变化
* 由 @Owen013 在 https://github.com/Novaenia/OWMouseFix/pull/4 修复了自由视角的bug


**完整变更日志**: https://github.com/Novaenia/OWMouseFix/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3

releases.name: Version 0.1.2
releases.body:
Fixes made by @Owen013, thank you!
* Fixes jetpack controls being jittery or locking up entirely while in zero-G
* Fixes player not turning with the moving platform or planet they're standing on
* The ship free look is not longer twice as sensitive on the X-axis.
releases.bodyZh:
@Owen013 的修复，感谢！
* 修复了在零重力状态下，喷射背包控制抖动或完全卡死的问题
* 修复了玩家无法随其所在的移动平台或行星旋转的问题
* 船只自由视角在 X 轴上的灵敏度不再翻倍

releases.name: Version 0.1.1
releases.body: fixed horizontal and vertical sensitivity not actually being 1:1 due to a one-line error
releases.bodyZh: 修复了水平方向和垂直方向灵敏度并非实际为1:1的问题，这是由于一行错误导致的
